Why do upgoat privileges scale only with CCP and not with SCP?

I think the main reason behind it is so that every gets involved and becomes a part of the community. By having it for CCP, this end goal can be achieved, whereas if it were SCP, then people might be more reluctant to post. There's a difference between posting a comment and planning out a post.
